boundary.summary: Team 07 manages STRUCTURAL BLUEPRINTS — domain-level specifications for what a design should contain. This is distinct from the existing design-template-engine which manages RENDERABLE TEMPLATES.

existingEngine.name: design-template-engine (Phase 1 + 2)
existingEngine.purpose: Manages renderable design templates: SVG/Sharp rendering pipeline, batch renders, ZIP delivery, visual asset output.

team07Domain.name: Universal Design Blueprint Library
team07Domain.purpose: Manages structural blueprints: domain contracts declaring canvas dimensions, zones, slot types, constraints, supported components, required data fields, and output capabilities. No rendering logic.
team07Domain.sourceOfTruth: ai_platform.ai_design_blueprints for custom blueprints; code (blueprints/*.ts) for built-ins

boundary.relationship: A blueprint is UPSTREAM of a template. A template may reference a blueprintId to declare its structural contract. The renderer (design-renderer/) operates on templates, not blueprints. Blueprints never contain rendering logic.
boundary.noRegistryCollision: Built-in blueprints use 'bp-<domain>-v<N>' IDs (e.g. bp-graphic-design-v1). Built-in templates use 'CATEGORY-INDUSTRY-STYLE-NNN' codes (e.g. LOGO-FOOD-BOLD-002). Namespaces do not overlap.

storageStrategy.description: Production uses DbBlueprintRepository backed by ai_platform.ai_design_blueprints. InMemoryBlueprintRepository is test-only and must never be used in production.
storageStrategy.builtinStorage: Code — services/design-blueprints/blueprints/*.ts. Always available, never in DB.

authStrategy.mutationRoutes: adminAuth middleware applied at BOTH router level (router.use(adminAuth)) and individually on each mutation route handler (POST, PATCH, publish, archive, deprecate, validate, check-compatibility, normalize).
authStrategy.publicRoute: GET /ai/design-blueprints/public — registered BEFORE router.use(adminAuth). Returns ONLY status=published blueprints. No auth required.
authStrategy.adminReadRoutes: All other GET routes sit behind router.use(adminAuth). Return all statuses.

visibilityRules.published: Public — returned by GET /ai/design-blueprints/public (no auth). Intended for customer-facing use.
visibilityRules.active: Admin-only — enabled but not public. Use for internal/platform-ready blueprints.

integrationNotes: Migration draft MUST be applied before write operations work. Read operations on built-in blueprints work immediately without the migration.
The DbBlueprintRepository handles 'relation does not exist' gracefully on reads (returns empty) so built-ins remain available before migration.
Write operations (POST, PATCH, status changes) will return 500 if the migration has not been applied — this is intentional; the service must not silently drop data.
Built-in blueprints have status=active, NOT published. They are not on the public endpoint by default.
To make a blueprint public: POST /ai/design-blueprints/:id/publish
knownRisks: Custom blueprints are lost on server restart until migration is applied (DbBlueprintRepository not yet connected to real DB rows).

Built-in blueprints have id format 'bp-<domain>-v1' which could collide with custom blueprint public_ids if caller manually sets a matching id. Guard: custom blueprint IDs are always prefixed 'bp-custom-<uuid>'.
